title: HIRA: A Human-in-the-Loop Retrieval-Augmented Cascade for Document Classification in Regulated Industries
abstract: arXiv:2608.21792v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Document classification in regulated industries is constrained by data residency, limited cold-start labels, scarce review capacity, and costly model-governance procedures. We present HIRA, a training-free, on-premises retrieval-augmented cascade for document classification in regulated deployments that combines BM25 over OCR text, dense text embeddings, and image-level representations through validation-calibrated weighted reciprocal-rank fusion. Confident documents are classified directly by retrieval; uncertain or visually confusable documents are passed to a locally hosted LLM verifier, which receives the OCR text, retrieved exemplars, label descriptions, and confusion-specific terms. When the verifier remains uncertain, the document is sent to human review. Each correction is stored as a margin-weighted retrieval exemplar and updates a Dirichlet-smoothed confusion graph, letting the system improve without updating model weights.   O

translated_title: HIRA：受监管行业中用于文档分类的人机协同检索增强级联系统
translated_abstract: 在受监管行业中，文档分类受到数据驻留限制、冷启动标签稀缺、审查能力有限以及模型治理流程成本高昂的约束。我们提出了HIRA，这是一种无需训练、本地部署的检索增强级联系统，专为受监管环境中的文档分类设计。该系统结合了基于OCR文本的BM25、密集文本嵌入和图像级表示，并通过验证校准的加权倒数排名融合进行整合。对于高置信度的文档，直接通过检索进行分类；对于不确定或视觉上易混淆的文档，则交由本地托管的LLM验证器处理，该验证器接收OCR文本、检索到的示例、标签描述和混淆特定术语。当验证器仍不确定时，文档将转交人工审核。每次修正都会作为边际加权检索示例存储，并更新狄利克雷平滑混淆图，使系统无需更新模型权重即可持续改进。
tldr: 本文提出了一种无需训练、本地部署的检索增强级联系统HIRA，通过结合检索、LLM验证和人工审核，有效应对受监管行业中的文档分类挑战，并支持系统持续改进。
en_tdlr: This paper presents HIRA, a training-free, on-premises retrieval-augmented cascade system that combines retrieval, LLM verification, and human review to address document classification challenges in regulated industries while enabling continuous improvement without model updates.
